t.rel: Since the regime fell in 2011, it has been split between rival governments in the east and west. Foreign powers such as Turkey, Russia and the UAE back each side, and it is a departure point for migrants to Europe.
t.korea: Korea's foreign ministry has placed it under a level-4 travel ban. A Korean construction company built its Great Man-Made River.
t.know: Libya has the largest proven oil reserves in Africa.
t.etext: It has Africa's largest oil reserves, and almost all its income comes from oil. Rival governments in the east and west fight over oil revenue, so production often stops.
